div.head: Iudex 10.1
div.ab: quia dominus et magister seculorum ait: Non solum male agentes, sed omnes consentientes digni sunt eterna morte.
Forðan se æðela middangeardes lareow cwæð: ‘Na ða áne ðe yfel doþ, ac ælc þara þe hit ðam dondum geðafiað, beoð wyrþe ðas ecean deaðes’.
Denn der edle Erdenlehrer [Paulus] sprach: ‘Nicht die allein, welche Übel thun, sondern jeder derer, die es den Thuenden gestatten, ist des ewigen Todes würdig’.
For the noble teacher of the world [Paul] said: ‘Not only those who do evil, but everyone who permits it to those who do it, is worthy of eternal death’.
For the noble [and] worldly teacher said: “Not only those who do evil, but also those who permit it are deserving of eternal death.”
